{"source_id":"MS002-SRC-A","verdicts":[
{"claim_id":"CL-0151","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0232 states minimizing total steps in creating a good prompt/skill/process and that you should do both the process design and output judging yourself, and EV-0233 states AI does the thing in the middle, going from 51.2% to maybe 80% success.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0232","EV-0233"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0152","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0233 states you probably won't achieve 100% success with any AI agent process as of the time of recording, and EV-0234 states AI lets you take more shots at the net and apply your own human intellect to pick the correct shots.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0233","EV-0234"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0153","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0234 says the ad generator won't aim to pop out perfect ads every time, and EV-0235 says it will generate dozens/hundreds/thousands of ads that you review and run, alleviating the creative bottleneck assuming that is the bottleneck.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0234","EV-0235"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0154","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0236 covers saving high performing ad formats as templates, feeding in a variable (niche/offer/angle) and Claude generating combinations, and EV-0237 covers review, pick and ship while staying in the loop until the end where taste matters.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0236","EV-0237"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0155","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0237 states the only situation where this makes sense is if creative is your bottleneck, EV-0238 describes the lots-of-ideas/lots-of-distribution/little-creative case improving meaningfully, and EV-0239 states that if you can already make ads or are short on ideas or distribution, more ad creation won't improve things much.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0237","EV-0238","EV-0239"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0156","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0181 states Claude Code and AI let them produce the manpower to give every person that works with the business a customized experience with customized creative, copy and outreach, and EV-0182 adds customized speed to lead, enrichment research and follow-ups.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0181","EV-0182"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0157","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0191 describes the hypothetical with lots of capacity at creative and lead steps but not booking, EV-0192 says improving creative, follow-ups or leads doesn't matter, and EV-0193 says moving booking from 10 to 20 units/day effectively doubles the business.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0191","EV-0192","EV-0193"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0158","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0242 explicitly instructs to map out the process ahead of time and follow the series of steps shown to convert your own marketing mix into something (replicable, per the sentence continuation).","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0242"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0159","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0243 states the first thing is to find a bunch of high performing ad formats and then save them as templates.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0243"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0160","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0243 says ideally your company already has high performing ad formats that have worked before with high ROAS, EV-0244 adds high LTV to CAC ratios and that since they don't have them he'll go find a bunch.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0243","EV-0244"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0161","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0244 says he'll open up Facebook ads library and EV-0245 says he'll look through a bunch of ads that people are running for a variety of products, in the context of not having his own formats.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0244","EV-0245"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0162","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0245 shows switching from Canada to 'all' on both filters and avoiding political ads.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0245"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0163","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0251 states he opens the ad detail and gets it as big as possible, and identifies the image bounds as what needs to be fed into the model.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0250","EV-0251"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0164","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0252 states going to Finder, to Downloads, making a folder and dumping them in, and EV-0253 names it 'ad formats for claude' with screenshots being taken.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0252","EV-0253"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0165","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0253 states he zooms in because he wants the creative to be as high quality as possible and then takes a screenshot.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0253","EV-0254"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0166","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0252 says 'why don't we do three to start' and EV-0255 says 'just one more to start... and then we'll get more complicated later on'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0252","EV-0255"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0167","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0255 states the ad is specifically for mobile and a little bit taller, and that this should natively figure out he is attempting to run a taller ad.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0254","EV-0255"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0168","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0256 says you would fill this folder with whatever your high quality ad formats are, and EV-0257 says you don't want to make a bunch of shitty ads, fill it with the best formats ever, and spin these formats as much as humanly possible.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0256","EV-0257"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0169","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0258 states the next thing needed is some sort of variable angle to feed in and that this requires a bunch of information about your business.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0258"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0170","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0262 states he will voice dump a bunch of stuff into Claude and have it come up with niches, offers, and angles.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0262","EV-0263"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0171","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0262 and EV-0263 state he clears the conversation so they are back to a base conversation, then pastes in the screenshot and presses the voice transcript button to prompt.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0262","EV-0263"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0172","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0263 and EV-0264 state that before creating the skill he will prompt back and forth to determine how best to structure the skill and eventually arrive at a set of high quality outputs.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0263","EV-0264"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0173","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0268 states they can't just use Stripe's or whatever company's logo fed in as ad format inspo, and EV-0269 states they need to replace that with Maker School, his own brand.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0268","EV-0269"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0174","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0270 states he feeds in the folder, notes you have the ability to feed in a folder, and that he has also given it a big prompt and an image.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0270"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0175","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0275 states Claude has no inherent ability to generate images and that they build a series of templates which are rules allowing Claude to generate them on demand using cheap old-school image processing, and EV-0276 names ImageMagick as such a platform.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0275","EV-0276"]}
]}
